nd01688ae69.headline: Dubai: Gold prices inch higher in early trade on first day of week
nd01688ae69.summary: Spot gold was steady at $4,248.93 per ounce on Monday morning in Dubai. Prices were inching higher in early trade on the first day of the week.
nd01688ae69.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a benchmark for safe-haven demand. Dubai is a major physical gold trading hub.

na54b3e3200.headline: Milan stock exchange continues positive trend with Europe and US futures, banks doing well, Leonardo surges
na54b3e3200.summary: The Milan Stock Exchange continued a positive trend in the first session of the week, in line with other continental European exchanges. Banks performed well and Leonardo surged.
na54b3e3200.why: Borsa Italiana operates Milan's stock exchange, the main venue for Italian equities such as banks and the defence group Leonardo.

n9a4631a1a2.headline: Safran invests €350 million in Moroccan industrial LEAP engine footprint scale-up, extensions
n9a4631a1a2.summary: Safran will begin construction in 2026-2027 on two LEAP engine maintenance facilities. It will also build a LEAP-1A assembly line and expand three existing sites in Morocco.
n9a4631a1a2.why: Safran is a French aerospace group that makes LEAP engines with CFM International, and its supply chain investments shape aerospace manufacturing capacity.

n32ef2a048b.headline: Markets rally: Sensex, Nifty extend winning streak; Reliance, PSU banks lead gains
n32ef2a048b.summary: Indian benchmark indices extended their winning streak for a fourth consecutive day, closing higher on Monday. Reliance and public-sector banks led the gains.
n32ef2a048b.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of India's stock market, and Reliance Industries is among the largest companies in the index.
n32ef2a048b.why_moved: Indian indices rose for a fourth straight session, with Reliance and public-sector banks leading the gains.

ncda15dce90.headline: Ley reveals tax cuts, backflips on unpopular policies
ncda15dce90.summary: Opposition leader Sussan Ley has outlined the coalition's priorities for the next election, including tax cuts, and appears to be reversing some unpopular policies.
ncda15dce90.why: The Coalition is Australia's main centre-right opposition alliance, and its tax and spending platform shapes expectations for future fiscal policy.

n02534f0470.headline: Miners delight in rare earths funding in US-Aust pact
n02534f0470.summary: Australia will step up production of gallium, neodymium and praseodymium and send it to the US under the pact, following an investment.
n02534f0470.why: Gallium, neodymium and praseodymium are critical minerals used in chips, magnets and defence products, and supply deals shape the economics of rare earth producers.

n7068e180bd.headline: Brits urged to keep records as HMRC online services face major disruption
n7068e180bd.summary: Brits have been urged to keep records as HMRC online services face major disruption, with Amazon Web Services reporting a global outage.
n7068e180bd.why: Amazon Web Services is the cloud unit of Amazon, and outages at major cloud providers can disrupt government and corporate online services.

n96fa104181.headline: Centrist Rodrigo Paz wins Bolivia's presidential runoff, topping right-wing rival
n96fa104181.summary: Centrist senator Rodrigo Paz won Bolivia's presidency with 54% of the vote. The result ends 20 years of rule by the Movement Toward Socialism party amid economic turmoil.
n96fa104181.why: Bolivia's president sets economic policy on natural gas, foreign exchange and public finances, which shapes investor risk in the country.

n46ef107fc1.headline: LTLs hold pricing line; Old Dominion announces 4.9% GRI
n46ef107fc1.summary: Old Dominion Freight Line announced a 4.9% general rate increase ahead of schedule. It is the latest less-than-truckload carrier to implement a pricing increase.
n46ef107fc1.why: Old Dominion is a large US less-than-truckload freight carrier, and general rate increases are its main pricing tool. Trucking rates are a read on freight demand and carrier pricing power.

nf3afffaa2e.headline: When Coty Loses the Gucci License — What Then?
nf3afffaa2e.summary: Analysts are assessing Coty's prospects after the €4 billion L'Oréal-Kering Beauty deal, with the future of Coty's Gucci license now in question.
nf3afffaa2e.why: Coty is a global beauty company that holds the Gucci fragrance and cosmetics license, a major source of its revenue.

impacts.why: Kering is a party to the €4 billion L'Oréal-Kering Beauty deal.

na989998778.headline: NFU says Argentina bailout sends mixed signals to farmers
na989998778.summary: The National Farmers Union president said the US taxpayer-funded bailout of Argentina sends mixed signals to farmers and ranchers, citing $20 billion in support.
na989998778.why: Argentina is a major global exporter of soybeans and grains, so US support for its economy can affect agricultural trade and farm policy.

n42fe9f5d1b.headline: State pensioners facing having to 'downsize' over November rule change
n42fe9f5d1b.summary: State pensioners face potential pressure to downsize over a November rule change. Chancellor Rachel Reeves will deliver the Autumn Statement on November 26.
n42fe9f5d1b.why: The UK Autumn Statement sets out tax and spending policy, which affects pension entitlements, public finances and gilt market expectations.

n2fad170bc3.headline: Paraguay seeks greater influence in divided MERCOSUR as trade with the EU gains traction
n2fad170bc3.summary: Paraguay is seeking greater influence within a divided MERCOSUR as trade with the European Union gains traction. MERCOSUR is South America's largest multilateral trade agreement.
n2fad170bc3.why: MERCOSUR is the South American customs union linking Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay, and its trade talks with the EU shape market access for regional exporters.

n1295de423d.headline: Auto Loan Delinquencies Surge Over 50% Since 2010
n1295de423d.summary: Auto loan delinquencies have risen more than 50% since 2010, with high car prices, interest rates and longer loan terms cited as drivers. Consumer debt exceeds $1.66 trillion.
n1295de423d.why: Auto loans are a large segment of US consumer credit. Rising delinquencies can signal household financial strain and affect lenders' credit losses.

n64a59c4a2f.headline: Gucci to sell beauty unit to L'Oreal for $7 billion
n64a59c4a2f.summary: Kering is selling its beauty business to French cosmetics group L'Oreal for more than $7 billion. The deal would transfer the Gucci beauty operations to L'Oreal.
n64a59c4a2f.why: Kering is the Paris-based luxury group that owns Gucci, while L'Oreal is the world's largest cosmetics company. Large brand divestments reshape both groups' portfolios.

impacts.why: Kering is the seller of its beauty business in this $7 billion-plus deal.

impacts.why: L'Oreal is the buyer of the Gucci beauty unit.

n7b82f33fd0.headline: Ripple-backed Evernorth set to raise over $1 billion in US listing to hoard XRP token
n7b82f33fd0.summary: Evernorth, a crypto venture backed by Ripple, will list on Nasdaq through a merger with blank-check firm Armada Acquisition Corp II. It is expected to raise over $1 billion.
n7b82f33fd0.why: Digital asset treasury firms hold cryptocurrencies on their balance sheets, and their listings link crypto token prices to public equity markets.

n223805ec22.headline: Australia's Albanese to discuss rare earths, security in first Trump summit
n223805ec22.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will hold his first summit with Donald Trump at the White House on Monday, seeking a bigger US commitment to Australia's critical minerals.
n223805ec22.why: Rare earths and critical minerals are essential inputs for electronics, defence and clean-energy manufacturing, so supply agreements matter to investors in these sectors.

n13f99dc397.headline: Gainers & Losers: RIL,  South Indian Bank among 7 stocks that moved most today. Here’s why
n13f99dc397.summary: Reliance Industries, South Indian Bank, CEAT and Polycab India rose on strong Q2 earnings, while JSW Energy and Tejas Networks fell on profit pressure.
n13f99dc397.why: Reliance Industries is a conglomerate spanning energy, retail and telecom, and its quarterly results are closely watched as a signal for Indian equities.

n71e85f4712.headline: China’s economic growth slows amid Trump tariff war and property woes
n71e85f4712.summary: China's GDP rose 4.8% year on year between July and September, down from 5.2% in the second quarter. The slowdown was attributed to the Trump tariff war and property problems.
n71e85f4712.why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major driver of global commodity demand and trade. Its growth pace shapes the outlook for Asian and global markets.
n71e85f4712.why_moved: Growth slowed from 5.2% to 4.8% in the quarter, which the report links to the Trump tariff war and property woes.

n1a4577da57.headline: Pakistan Posts $594 Million Current Account Deficit in 1QFY26 Despite September Surplus
n1a4577da57.summary: Pakistan recorded a current account deficit of $594 million in the first quarter of FY26, widening from $502 million a year earlier, despite a September surplus.
n1a4577da57.why: The current account balance measures a country's trade and income flows with the rest of the world and affects its currency and external financing needs.

n3a37556765.headline: Liberals say new anti-fraud measures coming with federal budget
n3a37556765.summary: The federal Liberals say they plan to direct banks to put new policies and procedures in place to detect and prevent fraud, with the measures coming with the federal budget.
n3a37556765.why: Canadian banks are regulated by federal authorities, so new fraud requirements would affect their compliance costs and operations.

n33598e63a0.headline: Global companies hit by more than US$35 billion in U.S. tariffs, but outlook stabilizing
n33598e63a0.summary: Global companies have flagged more than $35 billion in costs from US tariffs heading into third-quarter earnings, but many are lowering initial forecasts as new trade deals reduce exposure.
n33598e63a0.why: US tariffs raise input and import costs for multinationals, so tariff exposure feeds directly into corporate earnings guidance.

nf3bf6cf9d9.headline: Poilievre demands Carney cut taxes, keep federal deficit under $42B in next budget
nf3bf6cf9d9.summary: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre is demanding that Prime Minister Mark Carney cut taxes and keep the federal deficit under $42 billion in the coming budget. The figure is stated in Canadian dollars.
nf3bf6cf9d9.why: The federal budget sets tax policy and borrowing levels that influence Canadian government bond supply and economic growth. Deficit targets matter for ratings and yields.

n4b15009f63.headline: Trump’s righteous fight against the UN’s carbon tax
n4b15009f63.summary: President Donald Trump has successfully delayed the International Maritime Organization from passing a global carbon tax on shipping.
n4b15009f63.why: A carbon levy on shipping would raise fuel and compliance costs for shipowners and cargo flows, affecting marine fuel demand and freight rates.

nf2f375f927.headline: Salaried Class Now Pays 29% of Pakinstan's Income Tax
nf2f375f927.summary: Salaried taxpayers now contribute 29% of Pakistan's personal income tax. The Finance Bill expands the digital tax net and updates tax slabs, reshaping the revenue structure.
nf2f375f927.why: Personal income tax revenue is a key component of government finances, and tax slab changes affect household disposable income. Shifts in the tax base matter for fiscal planning and the IMF programme.

n456e642b37.headline: ADB, World Bank sign $3 billion agreement to boost lending capacity in Asia-Pacific
n456e642b37.summary: The Asian Development Bank said it signed a $3 billion sovereign exposure exchange agreement with the World Bank to boost lending capacity in Asia-Pacific.
n456e642b37.why: The ADB and World Bank are multilateral lenders that fund infrastructure and development projects across Asia, shaping sovereign borrowing capacity in the region.

n923fc1183a.headline: S. Korea's exports hit record high in Q3 on semiconductors, automobiles: Ministry
n923fc1183a.summary: South Korea's exports reached a new quarterly high of $185 billion in July-September, led by strong demand for semiconductors and automobiles, according to the ministry.
n923fc1183a.why: South Korea is a major exporter of memory chips and vehicles, so its export data is a closely watched read on global tech and manufacturing demand.

n240304c153.headline: Panera Bread Names Earl Ellis Chief Financial Officer | Restaurant Magazine
n240304c153.summary: Panera Bread has appointed Earl Ellis as chief financial officer, a finance leader who previously worked at Best Buy and Coca-Cola. He joins CEO Paul Carbone.
n240304c153.why: A chief financial officer oversees a company's financial reporting, capital allocation and strategy. Leadership changes at major restaurant chains are followed by investors and analysts.

source.name: Restaurant Magazine | Restaurant News and Reviews

sources.name: Restaurant Magazine | Restaurant News and Reviews

nfe3ef285bb.headline: Poilievre calls on Carney to keep federal deficit under $42B
nfe3ef285bb.summary: Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre is demanding that Prime Minister Mark Carney cut taxes and keep the federal deficit under $42 billion in the coming budget.
nfe3ef285bb.why: Canada's federal deficit and budget shape government borrowing, bond supply and fiscal policy, which matter for Canadian rates and the Canadian dollar.

nbe10f9332c.headline: Hiring will stay ‘subdued’ over next year due to trade war, data suggests - National | Globalnews.ca
nbe10f9332c.summary: Data suggests the Canadian job market will remain difficult to enter over the next 12 months, as most businesses report pausing growth and hiring plans amid the trade war.
nbe10f9332c.why: Labour market conditions drive consumer spending, wage pressure and central bank policy, all of which matter for Canadian equities and bonds.

n442e1e7740.headline: Senior citizens get 8.10% interest in this FD; see the list of banks offering highest interest rates on 5-year fixed deposits
n442e1e7740.summary: Small finance banks provide up to 8.10% interest on 5-year deposits for seniors.
n442e1e7740.why: Higher deposit rates attract savings, impacting liquidity and consumer investment behavior.

nba5ffec261.headline: Nikkei 225 breaks 49,000 and hits record as political stability returns
nba5ffec261.summary: The Japanese stock index rose more than 3% to a record level amid signs of political stability in Japan.
nba5ffec261.why: The Nikkei 225's performance influences investor sentiment and reflects Japan's economic outlook, impacting regional markets.

n7b831def2b.headline: GIFT Nifty up 205 points; here
n7b831def2b.summary: Indian stock markets reached new yearly highs supported by domestic factors and positive India-US trade relations, with upcoming earnings and global policies guiding sentiment.
n7b831def2b.why: Strong equity markets in India reflect economic growth prospects and investor confidence in the region.

n45f83beabd.headline: Australian defence deal to train PNG troops a 'win-win'
n45f83beabd.why: Defense aid and military cooperation can impact regional stability and geopolitical relations.

ndef053ad3b.headline: Festive Rally Pushes Sensex Up 411 Points, Nifty Climbs 133 As Markets Extend Winning Streak
ndef053ad3b.summary: Indian equity markets closed higher for the fourth consecutive day, supported by bank and oil-gas shares and positive earnings.
ndef053ad3b.why: Continued market gains indicate strong investor sentiment and economic resilience in India.

n193ba53f38.headline: CIA activity against Venezuelan leaders revives specter of US interventionism in Latin America
n193ba53f38.summary: The CIA's renewed activities in Venezuela recall historical interventions and regional instability concerns.
n193ba53f38.why: US covert actions can influence political stability, regional security, and energy markets in Latin America.

n640d88f7de.headline: Waaree Energies: Analysts see up to 23% upside after strong Q2 show, management guidance - BusinessToday
n640d88f7de.summary: Waaree Energies reported a 133% YoY increase in net profit for Q2, signaling strong performance in the renewable energy sector.
n640d88f7de.why: Waaree Energies is a key player in India's solar energy industry, and its financial results impact investor sentiment in renewable stocks.

nc4515ea87b.headline: HMRC set to sting UK households with penalty after slashing allowance to £3k
nc4515ea87b.summary: Tax penalties increase as the government reduces capital gains tax exemption limits.
nc4515ea87b.why: Tax policy changes influence household investment decisions and overall economic activity.

nea89021dc7.headline: Glow Lifetech Corp.: Glow Lifetech Provides Commercial & Corporate Update; Launches New Key Accounts, Advances National Expansion
nea89021dc7.summary: Glow Lifetech provides a commercial update, launching new key accounts and advancing its national expansion plans.
nea89021dc7.why: Glow Lifetech operates in the health technology sector, and its growth can influence investor interest in biotech and health stocks.

n6e332a25b1.headline: Hard work for inclusive growth begins
n6e332a25b1.summary: Pakistan emphasizes achieving 6-7% GDP growth to support inclusive economic development and avoid stagnation.
n6e332a25b1.why: GDP growth targets influence investment, policy planning, and economic stability in Pakistan.

ne1b453e1eb.headline: Yen eases as dovish Takaichi set to become Japan prime minister
ne1b453e1eb.summary: The Japanese yen declines amid expectations that Sanae Takaichi will become Japan's next prime minister, advocating stimulus policies.
ne1b453e1eb.why: Political leadership changes can influence monetary policy, currency movements, and market sentiment in Japan.

nf59ef91875.headline: China Q3 GDP growth slows to 4.8 per cent
nf59ef91875.summary: China's economy expanded at the slowest pace in a year in Q3, growing 4.8%, indicating a slowdown in economic activity.
nf59ef91875.why: GDP growth figures influence investor sentiment, currency, and policy decisions in China and globally.
